search_window.basis: Prior completed Food Line watch heartbeat fetched from ops/watch-ledger: 2026-11-03T08:43:03.653Z. Indexed local and official notices were searched using November 2–3 2026 wording and two-day recency, with eligibility restricted to verifiably new events since the prior heartbeat.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value recall; production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative and unchanged.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting only, sole, last or full-service local grocery store
Emergency food distribution cancellation or suspension from storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank closure or major service reduction
New official SNAP, WIC, EBT or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access impact
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closed fire November 2 2026 United States
"sole grocery store" fire closure November 2026 town
SNAP benefits outage delayed November 3 2026 state agency notice
WIC benefits interrupted system outage November 2 2026
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted queries returned usable discovery responses. No candidate was independently verified to represent a new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption after the previous check. Search output skewed toward previously reported incidents and November 2025 SNAP funding notices.

excluded_examples.reason: Eastport sole-store closure was previously reported in September 2026; no verified new Nov 3 development.
El Paso food-bank shutdown due to storm damage reported in September, outside new-hour window.
SNAP interruption notice concerns 2025 shutdown, not November 2026.
Holiday assistance resource guide and routine eligibility information; no abrupt pantry closure or official food-assistance interruption.

duplicate_screen.method: Read prior ops/watch-ledger heartbeat directly, screened events by publication date and whether an eligible development actually occurred within the observation period.

coverage_notes.limitations: This is limited search recall, not an assertion of complete nationwide coverage. Search engines returned mostly older reports despite a two-day recency filter; ultra-recent provider posts not indexed may be missed.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No content approved/published or changed; no task/schedule modification.
coverage_notes.scheduled_for_note: Invocation time used because execution preceded nominal scheduled recurrence minute.
